themes.nameEn: negative experience without a specific reason

reviews.text: Doesn’t work. I used this app years ago but stopped when my babies were born. Now that they’re a little older I wanted to start using it again, but every time I try to open the app it crashes. I can’t even get into the app at all.

EXACTLY WHAT I’VE BEEN SEARCHING FOR!. I was feeling discouraged trying to find an app that fit what I was looking for. I had almost given up until I came across this app! I am trying to get back into shape and I am an avid meditation person.

I needed an app that combine both meditation, slight movement and breath work. I decided to start with the Bed Yoga Meditations and I am beyond thrilled!

The library of exercises and meditations is wonderful. I don’t think I’ve loved an app this much in a very long time. This is definitely one I am going to pay for and keep for a very long time! 

Thank you for creating such an amazing app!
Best app!. I use this app every morning. Wake up yoga has the meditation to wake you up or yoga to wake you up with it’s a great app to have and I highly recommend it.
Used for many years now, best app ever.. Will continue to buy

So cool and unique. I am so grateful for this app. I wanted an alarm that would wake me up with a meditation to save me from the extra step of scrolling for meditations groggy when it’s already hard to create a new habit of meditating. I’ve had file glitched so far but customer service is exceptional, fast and responsive so five stars as they figure out the glitches! Grateful for the updates and free version!

Great workouts and instructors.. I’ve used this app for years, and really enjoy the routines. I don’t use the wake up feature. Instead I set my alarm and just play the wake up afterwards. One issue that I have had is with customer support. Recently I was unable to log in, and unable to restore my subscription. It took two days to get back my account. This only happened once in the many years that I’ve been using this app, but still, it was really annoying having the app tell me that I don’t have a subscription, and I do. They need a more responsive customer service system. In conclusion: Workouts- A
Instructors A
Customer service: C

Wish it worked. I used this app years ago and loved it. Started paying for the full version and it started out well. Then it stopped working. It would say there was an error initializing the alarm. Its a shame-I really liked it when it worked!
Love love love. Wonderful app that starts the day off right. Using iOS automation makes things seem less and reliable for morning alarms. A game changing way to start the day mentally and physically
Great for all ages.. Great app! My 9 yo loves it too. Very family friendly.
Expensive. The free app actually cost you more than $50 a year
The way to wake happy!. I love this app! I only wish the developers would partner with a good sunrise alarm clock company to pair this wake up with hi-lux morning light.

Alarm stopped working. I used this for about a month every morning and loved it but it stopped working. I reset it and still the alarm does not go off although the app says it did. Total waste of money.

Joyful Wake Up. I chronically have a very hard time getting out of bed, starting my day miserably and rushing to work. I used this app, and oh my gosh what a joyful way to wake up!!! The voices are so calm and soothing. I am stretching and easing my way out of bed. I highly recommend this app, and thank you to the developers!

This app has improved my wake ups!. I received a free trial as part of my FabFitFun box with the Accupillow. I loved it so much that I am now a lifelong member! I don’t hit snooze anymore, I wake up earlier and wake up more refreshed. The wakeups help me ease into the day and actually enjoy waking up!

Nice but needs a backup. I really, really like this app when it works, but it also frequently doesn’t. About once a week I’ll wake up to my backup alarm and a message like “file error”, or a failure message reminding me to keep the app open, which I always do. About 85% of the time it does work, but it’s frustrating that it isn’t consistent.

So bummed this isn’t a reliable alarm. Update: I did not renew my subscription after several attempts with customer service to fix the alarm not going off.
 I love love love waking up to Samora’s “Motivational Morning” but the app is unreliable as an alarm. So disappointing and frustrating. When it works there is no better way to start my day. When it doesn’t, by the time I wake up enough to realize the alarm didn’t go off, calculate whether I have enough time to do the practice and if so, start it myself, the moment is ruined.

Stopped working & no response from support. I loved this app for several years. Then various updates made it glitchy. Finally it stopped working for me altogether. Anytime I try to set and alarm I wake up to error message saying that it was canceled because another alarm was set. This happens when I have no other alarms on any other apps set. I reached out via email and chat for support and received no response. If it worked still I would be using it every day and give it 5 stars but an alarm app that doesn’t sound is worthless even if the content of the alarms is great.

Love this app for work breaks. I started using this app to wake up and now I use it for movement and meditation breaks throughout my work day. 

I was having back issues from sitting at my computer so much and I’ve now incorporated short 5-15 min sessions in my calendar. It’s great to break up my day with movement. I love how I can choose more energizing sessions or more calming sessions based on what I’m feeling (or wearing). 

Or I choose short guided meditations when my brain is feeling overloaded. Beyond my body, the sessions help me stay focused and I look forward to the little breaks.

I appreciate the selection of the instructors and enjoy having music with the sessions, feels like tiny retreats.

The Greatest. I do love this app it has so much content, you can find anything you are looking for by category and there’s something for every body, level, time of day and mood. I also love the alarm feature to start your day off intentionally and not put off your practice. Thanks L&J!

One stop shop for a better day!. Yoga Wake Up has it all: morning meditations, breathwork, yoga for sleep, bedtime meditations, acupressure…you name it, it’s on here! 100% worth the affordable subscription price for a healthier mindset and better day!

Good morning Sunshine. This last year I have been in chronic pain after a horrific accident. Yoga wake up has me starting my day with gentle stretches and easy flow. 
I think my favorite part is that I'm still laying in bed in pjs yet feeling like I'm accomplishing healthy healing habits. There are a few instructors that have the most soothing voices and their meditations turn me into a trance. I love this app. I think it works great for my needs.

Essential part of my daily routine. I’ve used Yoga Wake-up for a couple of years now, almost every morning and definitely every night (yes there are nidras and meditations for sleep). The experts and meditations are high quality-I quickly found favorites.

Love! Love! Love!. Whether you’re seeking an easier way to implement yoga into your life, need that extra boost on a morning, or simply want a softer way to start your day, this app is the wake up we all need. Love! Love! Love!
The best. I have a LOT of yoga/meditation apps, but this is my favorite. Totally worth the price because of the variety and quality options.

YogaWakeUp has it all. I love love love that this app is audio only. I’m so tired of having to look at a screen for everything! And it’s not just yoga. And it’s not just for waking up. There are great meditations on here too and practices for evening.

Lifesaver. I have been using yoga wakeup weekdays for several years now and it has been a lifesaver. I always add a loud alarm just in case the gentle one doesn’t wake me at first, but once I’m awake I am able to listen to the encouraging words and integrate stretching into my morning routine. I started slow with guided meditation and gradually progressed to gentle stretching in bed, finally advancing to morning stretches on a yoga mat. It works great with air buds too in case you don’t want your roommate to listen.

Life changer. I have two young kids and I have been trying to wake up before them for some peaceful moments before the day starts, but nothing could get me out of bed. I tried many apps, alarms, sounds and songs and nothing worked. I would simply hit snooze 12 times or turn it off completely. 
As a yoga teacher I we very intrigued when I saw this app, and it did not disappoint! Not only does it actually wake me up, it starts my day off right. I’m in such a more peaceful mood which is good for not only me, but my family as well. 
Thank you!!

What A Phenomenal App!!!. This app quickly made my top five must-have apps. What a great way to start the day. It increases my mindfulness, intentionality, productivity, sense of balance, and puts me in control of my attitude and actions for the rest of the day. I highly recommend it and wish I could give it six stars!!! 💛💛💛

Alarm won’t go off. I really hoped this was going to be a game changer for me, and on the mornings that it actually worked, I thought it might be. But the app is just too glitchy and unreliable to actually use. I watched the “how to set the alarm” video a bunch of times to see what I was doing wrong, and the answer was I was doing nothing wrong. Before going to bed I opened the app and made sure it said “silent ambiance is playing,” then in the morning it would say “you didn’t open the app last night so your alarm couldn’t go off.” Super frustrating and disappointing.

Best app I’ve ever downloaded. I had this idea that I wanted to wake up with yoga and I searched for an app to do that and lo and behold there was one. Not only was there one but it’s great! The app is easy to use and the instructors are amazing. It truly makes all the difference waking up everyday this way.

Unreliable. The app must be open for it to work, but even when I make sure it is open, the wake up does not always happen. Can’t rely on the wake up. Very frustrating, so I’m deleting. Loved the idea, but the execution doesn’t work.

So helpful for my sleep. I love this app. I struggle to have a good routine to get me to sleep, and I’ve tried a lot of YouTube and podcast meditations in the past. The sleep meditations put me to sleep every time! So many features of this app make it a seamless experience and easy to take for granted. For instance, when the meditation ends, the app doesn’t continue playing anything else. There’s also a feature to set a meditation for an alarm. 
All of the meditations I have heard so far are excellent. A great variety, and for various interests and needs. ❤️
Can’t be relied on for wake up. This app has to be open constantly in order to work. It crashes even if it’s open. Fine if you like the yoga but it cannot be relied on!!!
Great Way to Star My Day. Always makes me feel energized without abruptly waking me up. Fantastic

Seems to have improved a lot. I originally left a 2-star review after experiencing a lot of problems with the app, but I’m editing that now since those problems appear to have been corrected. The biggest problem was that the alarm wouldn’t go off reliably, even when I made sure to leave the app open (something I’ve never had to do for another alarm app). I kept using yoga wake-up, but had to make sure to always set a backup alarm. Recently, I realized that it’s been several weeks since I got any error messages or missed wake-ups, so I wanted to update my review. It really helps me to actually want to get out of bed, not just reach for my phone. I still took off a star because based on my past experience I don’t think it’s completely trustworthy as an alarm app.

Non-Functional, Frustrating, Anti-Peaceful, Anti-Yoga. I have tried so many times to use this app and it fails every time. So frustrating. Stay away!

First off : you will not get woken up if the app is not on before you go to bed. This is really not helpful and sounds doable. The fact is that I am not ok with changing my lifestyle, just for a piece of tech. 

Second: if you do load the app before bed it still does not work. Every time I try, I get an error in the morning - the file was corrupt and needs a new download. I download it and I get the same error the next day. So, no wake up, no yoga and confusion. 

If you want some nice meditations then this might be ok for you. You can get the same stuff without a subscription on other apps. 

As a “wake up” app, it’s TERRIBLE. DO NOT PAY. If you do, make sure you don’t pay full price.

Alarm didn’t work. I just downloaded the app yesterday and the alarm did not wake me up this morning. I had it set and opened. Following the directions to the T, and it still didn’t work. Kind of disappointing when it’s your first time. I’ll give it another go and hope it works tomorrow morning.
AMAZING. I didn’t know I needed this in my LIFE🤍🤍

Morning Must Have. This app is wonderful it has choices for morning, midday, and evening practices. If you want to try yoga or just add movement and breathing throughout the day, it is perfect. The instructors are fabulous and supportive. Just an all-around happy app! 🧘🏻‍♀️🧘🏻‍♀️🧘🏻‍♀️🧘🏻‍♀️🧘🏻‍♀️

Just download YouTube, Misleading/Another Scam Subscription App. Don’t even bother downloading this. Just use YouTube & search ‘love & kindness meditation’ or ‘your focus’ meditation if you want quality audio. Or, check out ‘waking up’ on the App Store: it has educational resources so you can better understand why meditation helps your physiology. 

Add this to the long list of clickbait mental health apps that seem to be circulating. I couldn’t even get through the setup session before it randomly cut off during a session to inform me that the app was actually subscription based app. Which makes me feel poorly for the people on here leaving amazing reviews since you can literally find these types of meditations for free on YouTube that are waaaaay better quality (the woman they hired for the session I heard was not exactly calming voice wise, I assume it’s probably just whatever chick started the app since that seems to be an ego-thing with a lot of these app developers). And there was no actual yoga involved in any of this (unless it was paid for, but seriously change the name of your app if you’re gonna make your focus still-meditation) which is extremely misleading given the title of the app. The setup of the app looks like it was copy and pasted from a number of other apps, really nothing special that’s worth paying to access fully. 

It’s really obvious that someone who can afford good therapy just took what they learned from their therapist & turned around to profit off of the fact that mental health help is hard to come by. All I was looking for was a super mild yoga for my chronic pain & instead I had to be reminded of the greedy pop-meditation experts trying to profit off of something that’s been free for so long. I hope the app developers reevaluate their intentions with this app & grow as people. It’s really heartbreaking to see stuff that’s supposed to help people being twisted into another way to make a profit.

Best wake up. I love waking up to these yoga exercises every morning, however every couple of weeks all the files become corrupted and won’t play until I redownload them which means they don’t go off in the morning which is really frustrating. Hopefully that bug can be fixed!

Great content but too inconsistent to keep paying for.. The sequences and meditations are lovely and uplifting, when the app actually works, but unfortunately, as some other reviewers have also said: this app is like a dice roll. Too often it will send me a notification that says, "You had an alarm set for this time, but the app is not running. Next time, please open the app at bedtime for the alarm to work." Which I DO, every night, but this entire past week it will only send the notification and not play the wakeup. Last night I even left the app open and just powered the screen off, and even though the app was open the wakeup would not play UNTIL I picked up the phone and unlocked the screen, and THEN it started immediately! I agree with what another reviewer said that if this app can be programmed to send a push notification at the time I have an alarm set for, WHY can it not just PLAY the alarm itself? The problems I have mentioned so far have been mentioned by several other reviewers going at least as far as two to three years back. Like other users, I also have to use another alarm app, one that works CONSISTENTLY without having to open it and HOPE that it may work (it's the standard iphone clock app), and then have YogaWakeup set to HOPEFULLY go off five minutes later. Two years ago, the developer responded to another reviewer saying (direct quote) "we are working on a new version that will allow us to run in the background," but that was TWO YEARS ago. The quality of the app content is great, but its lack of consistency to actually WORK even when you do as instructed with it means that I will likely not renew my payment subscription for it. I cannot justify paying for something that does not deliver what I payed for in a consistent manner, to the point that I'm already using a different alarm to wake me up anyway and just hoping that YogaWakeup will give me the nice end to "five more minutes, mom" in bed.

Feature missing: connecting to AirPods. I love this app, I love the feeling of waking up to yoga in bed! Unfortunately, I am unable to use the app with AirPods. The AirPods actually turn off once the app is opened. This would be a useful feature for me so I do not disturb my husband when doing early morning wake ups.
Subscription needed :(. I would give 5 stars if there wasn't a required subscription. I cant afford that.
Lost paid downloads. With this update all my downloaded wake-ups that I paid for are gone. Now it makes me buy a subscription. Total scam!

Doesn’t work. When the alarms/meditations play, I guess theres a sound glitch...they’re totally silent and so it doesn’t even make a sound. Can’t hear the meditations unless I manually go in the app and play them. Otherwise, I leave it open all night for more silence in the morning. I thought it just wasn’t playing the alarms..I got on and checked and it WAS playing, but no sound coming from the app anyway. I pulled up YouTube and it played fine. Must be the app.

Won't even let me sign up.. Absolutely awful! 10/10 would not recommend getting this app since you can't even SIGN UP! Why would you make an app if your viewers aren't even allowed past the log in page? The verification emails don't send, it won't let you sign in with apple, and the keyboard goes away multiple times so you have to restart the whole process multiple times without even getting an email. It's terrible!

Great concept, app needs work. I love this app when it’s working properly - unfortunately it doesn’t go off as an alarm about 50% of the time I set it.

The app requires you to be playing silent or ambient noise from the app in order to wake you up at your designated time. The problem is, if I open up any other apps in between setting the yoga alarm/ turning on the “silent noise” and my desired wake up time, it often interferes and my yoga alarm won’t go off. I listen to meditations from other apps to go to sleep and need a couple different alarms to wake myself up in the morning so it doesn’t work for me to only use this app and nothing else from the time I go to sleep until I wake up to do yoga.

That said, when it works I love this app. The meditations and breathing exercises that start from the bed and lead to yoga poses on my mat is the perfect transition and helps get me out of bed when I’m really feeling resistant to that.

I really hope the tech improves so it’s easier to use this app as a reliable alarm.

Mind / body essential. I love this app because it is a unique concept, beautifully designed, and has high quality content. You should have no reservations about purchasing and subscribing if you’re interested in doing short yoga / meditation sessions when you wake up. 

But, I do think it will be used differently depending on the person. When I first started using, I did the whole setting the alarm and opening the app at bedtime. It worked most of the time, and I even woke up and used it as designed. However, I have severe sleep problems, so it’s difficult for me to predict when I’ll be ready to get up, even when I adjust the alarm time based on my sleep. Plus, the meditations seem really quiet, compared to other apps, so they will not wake me out of a deep sleep. 

For these reasons, I’ve decided instead to start the wake ups manually in the mornings. I still set the alarm, but either I start the session before it goes off, or after. It still auto starts when you open the app. Sometimes, if I get lucky, I use it as intended, but more often I don’t. This is a reflection of me and my sleep problems, not the app. 

That being said, I do think there’s something low about the sound quality, because I often have trouble hearing the teacher and music, even when I turn the volume up. Unfortunately, you can’t connect to headphones or a speaker, because the app is designed to always play from the phone even if you connect to a bluetooth device. I would really just like to pop on my bedside headphones to do the sessions and hear them better, since I don’t use it like a traditional alarm. 

Otherwise, though, as a longtime yogi and person dedicated to self care and mental health, I love this app.

This App Changed My Life. I can’t believe how accessible, simple and consistent my yoga practice is now. It’s at my fingertips anytime I need it. From bed or on my mat. I gets so much value and the yoga and meditation teachers are awesome. Highly recommend for anyone who wants to create consistency and ease around their practice.
Amazing. Small company . I really wish them future love and success . I’m a customer for life

Fantastic Way to Start the Day!. I’m so thrilled to have found this app. I’ve been using it for a couple of weeks and and it’s made such a positive difference in the way I face the day. 
I actually look forward to waking up EARLY every day. It’s amazing how taking a little time and doing something positive can change my outlook. In these times, that positive energy is absolutely needed. 
Thanks for a great app! Namaste 🙏🏻

Ok. I actually love the app. But it does not run in the background. It eats up all my battery power and once even ran it out. If you can fix that and not having to open the app every day to set up that would be so awesome.
Excellent App!. I love it - fun and super easy to get me to do it daily. Thank you.

My Mornings are so much better!. I’ve struggled with my screen time ever since I got a phone and have found this app helps me wake up and meditate rather than reach straight for my phone! I really recommend it for anyone as it has helped me be a more positive person overall. The way you start your day makes all the difference and I think more people would be happy if they started their day out with guided breathing and a little movement

Waking Up & Staying Wake Just Got So Much Easier. I used to hit snooze a ridiculous amount of times. Or sometimes not even hear my alarm clock. Both of these drove my husband nuts. Now I wake up IMMEDIATELY and am EXCITED to start the day after using this program. I do choose to pause the recording as soon as I hear the voice start speaking, and then put on my headphones since my husband sleeps in later. But that’s a very small price to pay for starting my day the way I always wanted to.

Nightly set up isn’t convenient. When I downloaded the app, it said I have to open the app every single night and start my sleep time so it can wake me up. I did that and this morning, it notified me that I had an alarm set, but I didn’t leave the app open. It then didn’t even give me the option of hearing the alarm if I opened the app manually, following the notification. My only option is to try again tomorrow, but I doubt there will be a tomorrow. The app should just go off after an alarm is programmed, like every other app. This process is more stressful than waking up to a regular alarm.

Exactly what I needed. I have tried so many kinds of alarms over the years: beeping, ringing, music-playing. I always wanted an alarm that would talk to me to get me to wake up. Radio alarms didn’t cut it because I’d sleep through those, and podcast alarms didn’t become available until recently. Then came yoga wake up. 

The combination of moving my body and having someone speak to me makes me less likely to try to go back to sleep (though I do admit to still doing this sometimes). I can change up the recordings so that I never get bored or tune out the alarm.

I wish that you could set alarms that included the afternoon and evening routines. I just figured out so I can set an evening alarm to trigger my bedtime routine, but I can’t choose any sessions other than the ones intended for the morning. I know it’s called Yoga Wake Up, but if there are already recordings for different portions of the day, I don’t see why they couldn’t also be alarm options.

I also wish that there was greater racial diversity among the instructors in the app. There are very few people of color.

An amazing addition to my morning routine. I absolutely love this app. It gets my day started off on the right foot and has helped me break my habit of looking at my phone immediately when I wake up. A goal of mine has been to practice mindfulness and gratitude every day and this app has made it so easy for me to do that. 

One feature I would like to have added is the ability to add friends! My mom uses the app and we would love to be able to see each other’s progress and practices we have been doing. 

Truly a life changing app for me. Thank you!!

C’mon man!. I hate to give one star but the idea that I need to go into the app EVERY night to confirm I want the app the wake me up is simply ridiculous...If I’m paying for something, I should be able to set it to automatic. Deleting this until y’all get it changed...
Subscription. I was charged 9.99 for an app that I’ve never used. I contacted Apple for a refund thanks for my missing $10.

Sad business practice. So sad that during this time most companies are trying hard to provide some free level of services. But you guys are providing only a discount? Some people are unable to work or send their kids to school, are feeling particularly anxious or stressed, you don’t think you should show some good faith in providing better access to your database instead of only 2 free wake ups and an offer to sign up at a discount? Deplorable

Amazing way to wake up, game changer!. I’ve been using the app on and off for several months now and finally just jumped back on board. My mornings feel SO much better when I start my day with this app. So happy to be back on. It brings me into my body and breath, and helps me to keep my morning sacred before checking my phone or letting the rest of the world fill my head with info. The music, the teachers, and the design are awesome. Customer service has been excellent too when I had questions about using it as an alarm (you can hit play on a sequence when you’re ready or set your alarm with it which is the best!). Thank you!

A life changing app!!. This review is a long time coming. I’m not only just a user of this app but dear friends with the founders. Their dedication to this company and their teachers is truly one of a kind. They put so much thought and care into the content they put on the app!! They are honest and down to earth people that just want to see everyone around them happy and living a fulfilled in life.

For me, a tool that replaces your morning alarm clock with mindfulness and intention is a no brainer! Especially these days with so much research showing the first few minutes of how we start our day is imperative to a healthy mindset!! Highly recommend! I’m obsessed!

Beautiful Mornings. I have only tried some wake up in bed yoga and a meditation on here, but I can tell that the teachers are sincere, peaceful, and well practiced. I had a question for customer service, and Joaquin went way out of his way to help me. Just beautiful people and beautiful practices. I am slowly opening up to new ways of thought. Please, be patient with yourself and give this app the attention and chance that it deserves. Namaste.

Unreliable. I used the app successfully for a month or so and loved it. I paid for a subscription I loved it so much. However, after this last update the alarm no longer works. I used the app steadily for months and then the update happened and now it's useless which is incredibly frustrating. I emailed the company and got no reply so I'm leaving this review.
Good idea but. The first time I used it it didn’t go of and I was late for school. I bought the app to start out the day in a good mood but I couldn’t even start it out at the right time
Yoga. I love the app I love yoga as much as sex

Perfect start to a good day!. I love this app. I have chronic health issues and wake up in a lot of pain each day. This app is such a positive way to start my day. You can pick from tons of “wake ups”. Some are just meditations and a little movement, others have stretching and restorative yoga poses you can do in bed as you wake up. Then others get you up and doing standing yoga poses right next to your bed. They all have different themes and vary in length so you can choose what’s right for you each day. 
For someone who had a tough time getting out of bed each day, this has been a game changer. I start everyday on a more positive note. And it keeps me from looking at my phone or checking in with the world and letting all the noise in my head first thing when I wake up. At least now for a few minutes I’m feeling into my body, focusing on gratitude and connecting to my intuition - depending on which wake up I choose. I highly recommend this app.

Great tool/needs improvements. I love that I can set different alarms for different days and that there are a lot of different guides sessions to choose from.

I dislike that the app can’t be running in the background to work. I also dislike that I have to actively open the app for the alarm to work. This has been especially problematic since the app has crashed while I slept the last several nights. Getting a push notification in the morning telling me that I had an alarm set, that didn’t go off because the app was closed, is not helpful. Doubly so when the app was running when I went to sleep. If it can be programmed to send me a push notification at the time I had an alarm set for, I don’t see why it can’t be programmed to just alarm at that time (even if it’s without the full guided program.)

I also don’t find the sleep tracker to be useful at all. The minute I lay my phone face down on my night stand, it just assumes I’m sleeping. 

So, at this point I’m using two alarms one that actually tracks my sleep and goes off even if the app is closed. (It doesn’t sleep track if closed, but it still alarms!)

And then I’m using Yoga WakeUp set to go off 5 min later which doesn’t sleep track at all, but has a lovely, pleasant & useful alarm as long as the app has not crashed while I’m asleep.

Download issues and communication issues. So much for a zen yoga experience! Downloads aren’t working and my help message disappears. The in-app help is extremely limited so you are held hostage waiting for a reply while your PAID days go unused.

Not Loud Enough for Me. I noticed that this just isn’t loud enough for me, but I encourage you to try it. When I did hear it (about half the time), it was a great way to wake up. I’m sure some people will love this app. My alarm would wake me up 15 minutes later.

The voice talent is good and the sounds are decent. Overall I like the app, but it doesn’t work for me.

Great to Disappointed to Anger. So when I downloaded the app, I played and loved it. I loved it so much, I went ahead and grabbed a year’s subscription. I used it for a while and I figured that I was making a mistake when the alarm wouldn’t go off...until I really worked with it, and the alarm still wasn’t going off. I had recently changed phones so thought I could uninstall/reinstall and see if that would help as it did a few of my other paid apps. When I did that, despite putting in my proper credentials, I got sent back to the free app with no access to anything that I’ve had before. Highly disappointed and frustrated. Especially since I spent so much only 15 days ago. 
Any advice for how to get my information and access to the premium features?
I love it!!. I have only been using this for 2 days & I can already notice a difference in my attitude, mindfulness, & good vibes, as I slowly become present, & happy to be starting my morning!!

Could be better... Please listen to my review! I would love to see this change!. So, I've been meditating for over a year and half now and I was trying to find a new app to meditate to, not a replacement because I do pay a substantial amount for the current one I use daily... but I was also interested in PAYING for another because I really do like how easy it is to just open an app and literally FEEL like you are in a room with another person guiding you.. Well. Let's call the other app I use #1.. really the only thing that #1 does that this app doesn't do is allow the music to continue outside of the app, and continue when the guided meditation is over! The first time I listened to the meditation for Lower Back Stress Relief (which I would use probably daily as well, I am 34 years old and I am 6 months post-op from my 4th back surgery! They finally put in 6 screws, a couple rods, some artificial discs, some spacers in between the vertebrae...) my back felt amazing, my body went into a trance-like state.....UNTIL the music stopped!! And then I was like "Wait, What just happened?!" My husband snores sometimes, all night, right in my ear. He loves me so much that he can't stay away from me..even when we are sleeping. My 15 year old son snores so loud that we can hear him in our bedroom, therefore my 5 year old's bed is in our room until we move into a bigger house. For a while, the 5 year old was grinding his teeth pretty bad.. UGH!! I got used to sleeping with my Beats earbuds in, and got pretty comfortable listening to meditation music all night, eventually putting in earplugs around 3 or 4 am. 

The only thing that I would like to see change with this app so far, and I am subscribed right now, would be to have the option to allow music to play outside of the app and to allow music to continue when guided meditation is over..just replay it over and over! If some of the meditations aren't suitable, then don't allow it for that meditation, but I can say from listening to the Lower Back Stress Relief Meditation, the song would be just fine in a repeat mode!!!!! I would stay subscribed and would even recommend to others who I know that meditate!!! 

Please listen to my review!! I would love to see this change!!
